items.title_en: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.title_zh: Omarchy：任意用户进程均可提权至 Root
items.summary_en: A vulnerability dubbed Omarchy lets unprivileged user processes escalate to root in certain configurations. The write-up outlines the risk model, how escalation can occur, and what patches or mitigations are required to close the hole.
items.summary_zh: Omarchy 存在允许普通用户进程在特定配置下提权到 root 的漏洞。文章概述了风险场景、利用路径，以及修补与缓解措施。

items.title_en: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟重新推动 ProtectEU 策略中的加密后门
items.summary_en: EU's ProtectEU revives calls for encryption backdoors to aid law enforcement, reigniting a broader debate on security vs. privacy. The piece outlines potential risks to security, freedom of expression, and the viability of secure communications if backdoors are mandated.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟在 ProtectEU 框架下重新推动对称/端对端加密的后门需求，引发关于安全与隐私的激烈辩论。若被强制实施，会对通信隐私与安全性造成长期风险，同时可能削弱整体系统的安全性。

items.title_en: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
items.title_zh: Haiku R1/beta6 已发布
items.summary_en: Haiku OS releases R1/beta6, marking another step toward a stable, BeOS-inspired operating system. The beta focuses on hardware compatibility, performance improvements, and developer tooling as the community works toward a more complete 1.0.
items.summary_zh: Haiku OS 发布了 R1 的 beta6 版，向着稳定版又迈进一步。该版本在提升硬件兼容性、性能改进和开发工具方面做出努力，社区期待更完整的 1.0。

items.title_en: Europe's summer drought is so extreme that desertification is a growing threat
items.title_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱极端化，沙漠化风险上升
items.summary_en: Europe's summer drought reached extreme levels, stressing rivers, crops, and ecosystems and raising desertification risks across the continent.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱达到极端水平，威胁河流、农作物和生态系统并提升沙漠化风险。报道聚焦气候影响、水资源管理挑战以及政策应对。

items.title_en: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
items.title_zh: 加州通过 Linux 豁免年龄验证法
items.summary_en: California lawmakers unanimously exempt Linux and GPL-licensed software from the state's age-verification requirement, preserving open-source distribution channels. The move clarifies that common open-source licenses shield software from age checks while still applying to other content.
items.summary_zh: 加州立法者一致通过针对 Linux 与 GPL 等开源软件的年龄验证豁免，确保开源软件的分发不受额外年龄要求限制。这一举措澄清了在某些内容需要年龄验证时，开源许可的软件不受这些限制。

items.title_en: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
items.title_zh: METR 与 Redwood 提供 HuggingFace 黑客事件的事后分析
items.summary_en: The postmortem from Metr and Redwood details how a security incident at HuggingFace unfolded, outlining attack chain, misconfigurations, and remediation steps. It offers concrete lessons for securing open-source ML platforms and dependency supply chains.
items.summary_zh: METR 与 Redwood 的事后分析揭示 HuggingFace 安全事件的演变、攻击链与修复要点，并提出针对开源 ML 平台与依赖链的具体安全教训。

items.title_en: Hacking IKEA Furniture
items.title_zh: 改装 IKEA 家具
items.summary_en: A DIY guide shows how to hack Ikea furniture to add electronics or customization. It demonstrates affordable, modular DIY that can extend the life and utility of everyday furniture.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份关于如何改装 Ikea 家具以加入电子元件或自定义功能的动手指南，展示了低成本、模块化的 DIY 思路，能延长日常家具的使用价值。

items.title_en: The world may have less time than it thinks on climate change
items.title_zh: 全球在应对气候变化的时间可能比想象中更短
items.summary_en: A commentary argues that remaining time to avert dangerous climate impacts is shrinking due to faster-than-expected warming and tipping point risks. The piece implies urgency for rapid decarbonization, policy action, and resilient infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为由于温升高于预期以及潜在拐点的风险，全球用于应对气候变化的时间正在缩短。呼吁加速减碳、加强政策与基础设施韧性，以避免严重后果。

items.title_en: Coordination Headwind: How Organizations Are Like Slime Molds
items.title_zh: 协调风暴：组织为何像黏菌
items.summary_en: The piece argues that organizations resemble slime molds in how they coordinate: decentralized, adaptive, and efficient under changing conditions. It highlights implications for organizational design, workflows, and tech teams seeking resilient collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 文章将组织协调比作黏菌，强调去中心化、适应性强且在变化环境中高效运作。为组织设计、工作流和技术团队的协作韧性提供启示。

items.title_en: Claude Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default
items.title_zh: Claude 会话 URL 默认附加到提交信息和 PR 描述
items.summary_en: A default behavior in Claude code tools automatically appends the session URL to commit messages and pull request descriptions. This poses potential privacy leakage risks, and maintainers may need to disable or patch the feature.
items.summary_zh: Claude 相关工具默认会将会话 URL 附加到提交信息与 PR 描述中，存在隐私泄露风险。维护者可能需要禁用或修补此功能。

items.title_en: Why open source rocks – a new SM750 (Silicon Motion GPU) HDMI Driver
items.title_zh: 开源为何很给力——新款 SM750 GPU 的 HDMI 驱动
items.summary_en: A new open-source HDMI driver for the SM750 GPU demonstrates how community-driven software can extend legacy hardware. It improves compatibility with modern Linux stacks and makes customization easier for hobbyists and device manufacturers.
items.summary_zh: 为 SM750 GPU 推出的开源 HDMI 驱动展示了社区驱动的软件如何延长旧硬件的生命。它提升了与现代内核的兼容性，并为爱好者和设备厂商带来更多定制空间。

items.title_en: Running SQLite Apps on Docker and Kubernetes with Litestream
items.title_zh: 在 Docker 与 Kubernetes 上使用 Litestream 运行 SQLite 应用
items.summary_en: Litestream enables durable, cloud-native SQLite deployments by streaming writes to object storage, letting SQLite apps run safely in Docker and Kubernetes without a separate server. The post walks through setup tradeoffs, performance considerations, and scenarios where this approach shines.
items.summary_zh: Litestream 通过把写入数据流式传送到对象存储，使 SQLite 应用能够在 Docker 和 Kubernetes 上实现持久化与云原生特性。文中讨论了部署要点、性能取舍，以及此方案适用的用例。

items.title_en: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.title_zh: QubesOS 拷贝到 VM 错误报告回传通道可实现任意代码执行
items.summary_en: A security disclosure shows a backchannel in Qubes OS’ copy-to-VM error reporting that can be abused to execute arbitrary code inside a target VM. The fix tightens isolation guarantees and reminds users to apply updates to preserve containment boundaries.
items.summary_zh: 安全披露显示 Qubes OS 的拷贝到 VM 的错误报告回传通道可被利用来在目标 VM 内执行任意代码。修复加强了隔离性，并提醒用户及时更新以维持封装边界。

items.title_en: Longest Straight Line Paths on Water or Land on the Earth (2018)
items.title_zh: 地球表面水域或陆地上的最长直线路径（2018）
items.summary_en: A geographic study analyzes the longest straight-line routes that can run entirely over water or land on Earth, revealing how coastlines and geography constrain such paths. The findings illuminate interesting quirks in global layouts and have implications for navigational puzzles and geodesic research.
items.summary_zh: 这一地理研究探讨在地球上完全在水域或陆地上绘制的最长直线路线，揭示海岸线和地形如何对路径造成约束。研究结果揭示全球地形的有趣特性，并对导航谜题和测地线研究具有启示意义。

items.title_en: Bug Blindness
items.title_zh: 漏洞盲点
items.summary_en: A deep dive into why developers consistently miss bugs, even in well-tested code, due to cognitive biases and organizational blind spots. The piece argues for stronger testability, structured debugging workflows, and diverse perspectives to counteract bug blindness.
items.summary_zh: 本文剖析开发者在经过多轮测试后仍漏掉缺陷的原因，源于认知偏差和组织层面的盲点。通过强调可测试性、结构化调试流程和多样化视角来对抗漏洞盲点。

items.title_en: Creepy Crawlies
items.title_zh: 令人毛骨悚然的爬虫
items.summary_en: Creepy Crawlies
items.summary_zh: 简要地反思软件与系统中那些诡异、常被忽视的细节。

items.title_en: Zig: Pointer Stability for ArrayLists
items.title_zh: Zig：ArrayLists 的指针稳定性
items.summary_en: Zig devlog details improvements to ArrayList pointer stability, enabling safer growth without invalidating references and improving performance guarantees for systems code. This work helps Zig approach memory-safety goals while staying close to low-level control.
items.summary_zh: 开发日志介绍了 Zig 在 ArrayList 指针稳定性方面的改进，确保在扩容时不失效引用并提升性能保证。该工作有助于 Zig 在追求内存安全的同时保持对底层控制的灵活性。

items.title_en: Lawmakers added $1 to car insurance policies. That money paid for Flock cameras
items.title_zh: 立法者在车险中多收1美元，用于资助Flock摄像头
items.summary_en: A modest insurance surcharge earmarked to fund Flock cameras reveals how state policy links private pricing with public surveillance infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 一笔用于资助 Flock 摄像头的车险附加费反映出政府将私人定价与公共监控基础设施连结的做法。文章讨论公共安全资金与消费者成本之间的权衡。

items.title_en: 'They shot all their weapons; they trashed their ships; they ran out of money'
items.title_zh: 他们把所有武器都用光、船只被毁、钱也花光了
items.summary_en: The Guardian piece argues that Google complied with Trump's 'Lake America' map rename order, illustrating a broader pattern of tech industry capitulation to political pressure. It analyses implications for policy, platform governance, and user expectations.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出 Google 遵循特朗普的‘Lake America’ 地图改名指令，折射科技行业对政治压力的趋附趋势及其对治理和用户体验的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Debian: Retiring from the Project (Vv221)
items.title_zh: Debian：从项目中退休
items.summary_en: Debian developer announces retirement from the Debian project, reflecting on community governance, sustainability, and how long-term stewardship shaped the distro.
items.summary_zh: Debian 社区宣布某成员从项目退休，回顾了社区治理、可持续性以及长期维护对发行版的重要影响。

items.title_en: Cores in space: The core memory module from a 1980 Spacelab computer
items.title_zh: 太空中的核心记忆：来自 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机的核心内存模块
items.summary_en: Explores a magnetic core memory module recovered from a 1980 Spacelab computer, illustrating how early memory technology worked and why it mattered for aerospace reliability. The piece connects vintage hardware to contemporary memory concepts, highlighting lessons in durability and engineering trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 讲述从 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机中回收的核心内存模块，展示早期内存技术的工作原理及其在航天领域的可靠性作用。文章将老派硬件与现代内存概念联系起来，强调耐用性和工程取舍的经验。

items.title_en: DHS is using obscure law to snoop on journalists, non-profits, unions
items.title_zh: DHS 利用冷门法律监视记者、非营利组织与工会
items.summary_en: New reporting shows DHS used an obscure summons power to obtain data on journalists, nonprofits, and unions, widening concerns about civil-liberties protections and government overreach. The piece underscores the chilling effect on press and civil-society work and calls for greater transparency and reform.
items.summary_zh: 最新报道揭示国土安全部利用一项冷门的传唤权调取记者、非营利组织和工会的数据，扩大了对公民自由与政府越权的担忧。该事件凸显对媒体与民间社会工作的震慑效应，并呼吁提高透明度与推进改革。

items.title_en: Brits would quite like their private messages to stay private
items.title_zh: 英国人希望私信保持私密
items.summary_en: Poll results suggest Brits want stronger privacy protections for private messages, reflecting concerns about law-enforcement access and metadata. The discussion hints at potential political pressure for messaging-app privacy features.
items.summary_zh: 民意调查显示英国人希望私密消息获得更强保护，反映对执法访问和元数据的担忧。讨论暗示可能推动在消息应用隐私功能上的政治压力。

items.title_en: Automating Immersive Reading
items.title_zh: 自动化沉浸式阅读
items.summary_en: A piece on automating immersive reading, likely combining text highlights, audio narration, or interactive features to enhance reading engagement, using tooling or browser features.
items.summary_zh: 探讨如何通过自动化工具提升沉浸式阅读体验，结合文本高亮、语音朗读等功能，提升专注度与理解。

items.title_en: Hy4 preview
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布并开源 Hy4 预览版
items.summary_en: Hy4 is Tencent's next large AI model with preview release and open-sourced components, expanding access to its latest AI stack. The move strengthens Tencent's position in the AI race and contributes to the broader open-source ecosystem, particularly for Chinese-language models and multimodal capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 腾讯发布了 Hy4 预览版并开源了核心组件，扩大了对其最新 AI 技术栈的接入。此举提升了腾讯在 AI 竞争中的地位，并为开放源生态做出贡献，特别是在中文模型与多模态能力方面。

items.title_en: One Nix flake to rule them all
items.title_zh: 一个 Nix flake 通吃全部
items.summary_en: A design post arguing for a single, universal Nix flake to streamline reproducible dev environments and CI, reducing drift and onboarding friction. It discusses trade-offs and practical tips.
items.summary_zh: 一篇设计文章提出用一个统一的 Nix flake 来简化可重复的开发环境与 CI，降低偏差与上手难度，并讨论权衡与实用要点。

items.title_en: Good Culture Is the Biggest Productivity Hack, Not AI
items.title_zh: 良好文化才是最大的生产力秘诀，而非 AI
items.summary_en: Culture remains the biggest driver of productivity; AI alone won't compensate for lack of trust, clarity, and collaboration. The piece argues leaders should invest in culture—psychological safety, shared goals, and effective teamwork—to truly boost output.
items.summary_zh: 文化才是生产力的最大推动力，AI 工具若缺乏信任、清晰目标和协作也难以带来真正的产出提升。文章建议领导者把资源投入到文化建设上——营造心理安全、明确共同目标、高效协作，以实现生产力的倍增。

items.title_en: 1kB Website as Status Symbol
items.title_zh: 以 1KB 网站作为地位象征
items.summary_en: A project highlights building a 1kB website as a brag-worthy feat, pushing the boundaries of minimalism and performance.
items.summary_zh: 这个项目把 1KB 网站作为炫技成就，挑战极小化与性能边界。通过对约束的利用来驱动设计，强调在拥挤的网络环境中微小网站为何能获得关注。

items.title_en: Building my own network stack
items.title_zh: 打造我自己的网络协议栈
items.summary_en: A hands-on account of building a personal network stack, likely referencing the DN42 project (a private internet), detailing design choices, challenges, and learning outcomes from implementing routing and TCP/IP basics.
items.summary_zh: 记录亲自搭建网络协议栈的过程，分享在 DN42 等私有网络环境中的设计取舍、遇到的挑战与收获。

items.title_en: Google's Obedience to Trump's "Lake America" Order Follows a Depressing Pattern
items.title_zh: 谷歌对特朗普‘Lake America’命令的服从反映出令人沮丧的模式
items.summary_en: Google policies on renaming maps to reflect Trump's 'Lake America' directive illustrate a pattern of tech platforms bending to political pressure, raising concerns about platform governance and user trust.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌对特朗普“Lake America”指令的遵从，折射科技平台屈从政治压力的趋势，引发对治理与用户信任的担忧。

items.title_en: Norway Shrugged
items.title_zh: 挪威的耸肩：科技政策的思考
items.summary_en: A concise look at Norway's nuanced approach to tech policy and governance, balancing innovation with privacy and public safeguards.
items.summary_zh: 这篇简短评述聚焦挪威在科技政策与治理上的微妙平衡，既推动创新又兼顾隐私与公共安全。

items.title_en: El Niño Will Be Unlike Any in the Past Eight Decades
items.title_zh: 厄尔尼诺将不同于过去八十年的任何时期
items.summary_en: El Niño is expected to be unusually strong or behave differently from the last eight decades, with widespread impacts on weather, agriculture, and energy supply.
items.summary_zh: 厄尔尼诺现象预计将不同于过去八十年的任何一次，对全球天气、农业和能源供给产生广泛影响。文章探讨这些变化对风险规划与气候模型的影响。

items.title_en: The Rise and Fall of Agent Civilizations
items.title_zh: 代理文明的兴衰
items.summary_en: An exploration of AI agent ecosystems and the dynamics by which multiple agents could form 'civilizations'—with attention to collaboration, competition, and potential collapse. It highlights strategic, safety, and governance challenges as AI agents multiply.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 代理人生态系统及其多代理协作形成“文明”的可能性与动态，关注协作、竞争与潜在崩溃的情景。强调随着代理数量增加，治理、安全与策略的挑战。

items.title_en: FreeCORE TrueNAS Core – Continued
items.title_zh: FreeCORE 继续推进 TrueNAS Core
items.summary_en: FreeCORE continues the TrueNAS Core project, signaling ongoing community-led updates to the NAS OS. The note underscores the resilience of open-source forks and the role of user contributions in sustaining storage-focused platforms.
items.summary_zh: FreeCORE 继续推进 TrueNAS Core 项目，表明社区驱动的 NAS 操作系统仍在持续更新。强调开源分支的韧性，以及用户贡献在维持存储平台中的作用。

items.title_en: An implementation of Conway's Game of Life for Windows 3.1x and later
items.title_zh: 面向 Windows 3.1 及更高版本的康威的生命游戏实现
items.summary_en: A retro-friendly implementation of Conway's Game of Life runs on Windows 3.1x and newer, preserving a classic cellular automaton in early Windows environments. It highlights early software portability and enthusiasm for classic demos.
items.summary_zh: 在 Windows 3.1 及后续版本上实现的康威生命游戏，保存了这一经典细胞自动机在早期 Windows 环境中的风貌，体现早期软件移植热情。

items.title_en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
items.title_zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜
items.summary_en: NASA's Roman Space Telescope will use a wide-field infrared imager to study dark energy and exoplanets at unprecedented survey scales. It represents a major leap for space astronomy, delivering large-scale cosmic maps that complement JWST and ground-based surveys.
items.summary_zh: 美国国家航空航天局的罗曼太空望远镜将使用广域红外成像仪进行大规模的宇宙勘测，着眼于暗能量与系外行星的统计学研究。该任务标志着天文观测的一个重大跃进，所取得的大范围宇宙图像将与 JWST 及地面观测互为补充。

items.title_en: Fair Work Commission condemns 'plain wrong' AI legal advice
items.title_zh: 公平工作委员会谴责“完全错误”的 AI 法律建议
items.summary_en: Australia’s Fair Work Commission condemns AI-provided legal advice as plainly wrong, underscoring the risk of relying on automated guidance in regulated contexts. The episode stresses human oversight and clear disclosure of AI limits.
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚公平工作委员会谴责 AI 提供的法律意见明显错误，凸显在受监管场景中依赖自动化指引的风险。该事件强调需要人工审查并清晰披露 AI 的局限性。

items.title_en: monty-go: Pure-Go wrapper for Pydantic's Monty Python Interpreter
items.title_zh: monty-go：Pydantic Monty Python 解释器的纯 Go 封装
items.summary_en: Monty-go provides a pure-Go wrapper around Pydantic's Monty Python interpreter, enabling Go projects to leverage Python type handling and evaluation without CPython. It simplifies cross-language tooling.
items.summary_zh: monty-go 为 Pydantic 的 Monty Python 解释器提供纯 Go 封装，使 Go 项目可以在不依赖 CPython 的情况下使用 Python 的类型处理与解释能力。

items.title_en: Htmx 4.0
items.title_zh: Htmx 4.0 发布
items.summary_en: Htmx 4.0 launches with a refreshed API surface and broader server-driven UI capabilities, further simplifying dynamic pages without heavy JavaScript frameworks. The release tightens bindings around hx- attributes and adds improvements for streaming and partial updates, keeping htmx attractive for developers seeking low-friction interactivity.
items.summary_zh: Htmx 4.0 发布，API 面貌焕新，扩展了服务器驱动的 UI 能力，进一步简化在不依赖大规模 JS 框架的情况下实现动态页面的开发。新版本加强了对 hx- 属性的集成，并在流式更新与局部页面更新方面带来改进，继续巩固了它在追求低摩擦交互的开发者中的定位。

items.title_en: Startup Anti-Patterns
items.title_zh: 初创企业的反模式
items.summary_en: A primer on startup anti-patterns that trap early-stage teams—from vanity metrics to misaligned incentives. The series encourages teams to focus on sustainable product-market fit, clear milestones, and customer feedback.
items.summary_zh: 简要介绍初创企业常见的反模式：从虚荣指标到目标错位等。系列内容鼓励团队聚焦可持续的产品-市场匹配、明确的里程碑和用户反馈。

items.title_en: 12TB Steam leak reveals unseen Half-Life 2: Episode 3 builds
items.title_zh: 12TB 泄漏揭示未公开的 Half-Life 2: Episode 3 构建
items.summary_en: A massive 12TB leak surfaces unseen HL2: Episode 3 builds and assets, offering a window into Valve's abandoned project and the evolution of game development pipelines. It raises IP and archival questions.
items.summary_zh: 一份12TB 的泄漏曝光了尚未公开的《半条命2：Episode 3》构建与资源，揭示了开发流程的早期阶段与放弃项目的历史，同时引发知识产权与档案保存的讨论。

items.title_en: Boot a Virtual iPhone via Apple's Virtualization.framework
items.title_zh: 通过苹果的 Virtualization.framework 启动虚拟 iPhone
items.summary_en: A hobbyist demonstrates how to boot a virtual iPhone using Apple's Virtualization.framework, effectively running iOS as a VM on a host. The project shows the feasibility of isolating and testing iOS software without real hardware, unlocking new avenues for development, debugging, and security research. It remains experimental and depends on sensitive tooling and compliance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 开发者通过苹果的 Virtualization.framework 展示了如何引导一个虚拟 iPhone，在宿主机上运行 iOS 的虚拟机。该项目证明了在无实体设备的情况下测试和调试 iOS 的可行性，为开发、安全研究及隔离测试开辟新路径。此实现尚属实验性，且涉及工具与合规风险。

items.title_en: Calibrate Before You Accelerate: Bias Toward Action in a New Role
items.title_zh: 先校准再加速：在新岗位上培育行动导向
items.summary_en: Calibrate first: clarify expectations with your manager, map key stakeholders, and learn the domain before making big bets. Create a concrete 30-60-90 day plan, seek early feedback, and align success metrics with your team.
items.summary_zh: 先对新角色进行校准：与上级明确期望、梳理关键干系人，并在真正行动前熟悉领域。制定一个具体的 30-60-90 天计划，及早寻求反馈，并将成功指标与团队对齐。

items.title_en: Xcena and Samsung's Near Memory Compute CXL Device
items.title_zh: Xcena 与三星的近内存计算 CXL 设备
items.summary_en: Hot Chips coverage describes a near-memory compute device from Xcena and Samsung that uses CXL to place compute closer to memory, reducing latency for AI workloads. This signals a broader shift toward memory-centric datacenter architectures and off-GPU acceleration.
items.summary_zh: Hot Chips 报道描述了 Xcena 与三星联合推出的近内存计算 CXL 设备，利用 CXL 将计算贴近内存，降低 AI 工作负载的延迟。这标志着向内存为中心的数据中心架构和对非 GPU 加速的更广泛转变。

items.title_en: Algorithmic rent-pricing litigation expands under new state and local laws
items.title_zh: 算法化租金定价诉讼在新州和地方法律框架下扩展
items.summary_en: Legal analysis noting how algorithmic rent-pricing disputes are expanding under new state and local laws, affecting landlords, tenants, and tech providers. It covers risk areas, regulatory trends, and implications for property-tech startups.
items.summary_zh: 法律分析指出，随着新州和地方法规出台，算法定价租金的诉讼范围在扩大，影响房东、租客及相关技术提供商。讨论风险点、监管趋势及对物业科技创业公司的影响。

items.title_en: Benjamin Franklin’s alter egos gave him the most freedom
items.title_zh: 本杰明·富兰克林的替身让他获得最大的自由
items.summary_en: Historical profile showing how Franklin’s alter egos gave him greater freedom to publish, experiment, and communicate across social and political boundaries. The piece uses Franklin as a lens on persona as a tool for intellectual liberty.
items.summary_zh: 通过本杰明·富兰克林利用替身扩大自由的历史案例，揭示化名如何帮助他在社交与政治界限间自由地发表、尝试与传播思想。将化名视为获得知识自由的工具。

items.title_en: Samsung's Processing-in-Memory (PIM)
items.title_zh: 三星的内存就近处理（PIM）技术
items.summary_en: Samsung showcased its Processing-in-Memory (PIM) approach at Hot Chips 2026, aiming to move compute closer to DRAM to cut data movement. The prototypes emphasize near-memory accelerators and lightweight logic inside memory arrays, targeting AI and high-performance workloads with better throughput and energy efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 三星在 2026 年 Hot Chips 会议上展示了其内存就近处理（PIM）方案，意在把计算带到接近 DRAM 的位置以减少数据搬运。该方案在内存阵列中嵌入近存加速单元和简化逻辑，面向 AI 等工作负载提升吞吐与能效潜力。

items.title_en: Being kicked out of the tech industry
items.title_zh: 被赶出科技行业
items.summary_en: A personal essay about barriers, discrimination, or burnout that lead someone to leave tech, highlighting the human cost of tech culture. It underscores the need for inclusive environments and supportive careers.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇个人随笔，讲述离开科技行业背后的挫折、排斥与倦怠，以及科技文化对个人的代价。呼吁建立更具包容性的工作环境和更具支持性的职业路径。

items.title_en: Just the rumour of a bug is enough to find an exploit these days
items.title_zh: 只凭传闻即可发现漏洞的时代
items.summary_en: Security researchers note that attackers can weaponize unverified bug rumors to craft exploits or pressure patch delays.
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用未证实的漏洞传闻就能催生利用方法，或逼迫厂商拖延修补。文章强调传闻驱动的利用风险，呼吁更强的披露机制和快速、可验证的修复。

items.title_en: I accidentally turned LLM memory into program analysis
items.title_zh: 我不小心把大语言模型记忆变成了程序分析工具
items.summary_en: A personal project reveals that persistent attention memory in large language models can be repurposed for static and dynamic program analysis tasks. By treating the model's remembered state as a proxy for program state, the author demonstrates new debugging workflows, memory-safe reasoning, and potential tooling shifts for developers.
items.summary_zh: 作者偶然发现把大语言模型的记忆用于程序分析成为可能，为静态与动态分析任务提供新思路。通过把模型记忆映射到程序状态，展示了新的调试流程、内存安全推理，以及对开发工具链潜在的影响。

items.title_en: Functional State Machines in Rust: Typestate and Newtype Patterns
items.title_zh: Rust中的函数式状态机：Typestate与Newtype模式
items.summary_en: Rust’s functional state machines article shows how typestate and newtype patterns can enforce transitions at compile time, preventing illegal state changes. By encoding state into types, you get safer, self-documenting code for protocol handling, parsers, and workflow engines.
items.summary_zh: 文章展示如何用 typestate 与 newtype 模式在 Rust 中实现编译期状态机，防止非法状态转移。通过将状态编码进类型，能为协议处理、解析器和工作流引擎带来更安全、可自文档化的实现。

items.title_en: Cheap GPS Jammers Are Filling the World with Navigation Dead Zones
items.title_zh: 廉价 GPS 干扰器充斥，导航死区成灾
items.summary_en: The availability of cheap GPS jammers is creating navigation dead zones for vehicles and services, undermining critical infrastructure like aviation, shipping, and emergency services. The piece calls for stronger regulation and resilient location technologies.
items.summary_zh: 廉价 GPS 干扰器泛滥造成导航死区，影响航空、航运和紧急服务等关键基础设施。文章呼吁加强监管并推进更鲁棒的定位技术。

items.title_en: What We Tell AI
items.title_zh: What We Tell AI
items.summary_en: What We Tell AI presents insights into how language models are shaped by human prompts, data curation, and safety policies, and the consequences for AI behavior and reliability.
items.summary_zh: What We Tell AI 探讨人类提示、数据筛选与安全策略如何塑造语言模型的行为与可靠性，以及由此带来的后果。

items.title_en: StemDeck, a free, open-source and local AI stem separator
items.title_zh: StemDeck：免费开源、在本地运行的 AI 音轨分离工具
items.summary_en: StemDeck offers free, open-source AI-driven audio stem separation that runs locally on your machine. By processing offline, it avoids cloud privacy concerns and can leverage your hardware for faster results, making it attractive for musicians and audio engineers exploring stem remixing.
items.summary_zh: StemDeck 提供免费、开源的 AI 音轨分离工具，能够在本地计算机上离线运行。避免云端传输带来的隐私风险，并能充分利用本地硬件提升处理速度，成为音乐人和音频工程师进行分轨再混音的有力工具。

items.title_en: Domain-Driven Agents
items.title_zh: 领域驱动的智能体
items.summary_en: Domain-Driven Agents blends domain-driven design with autonomous AI agents to align behavior with business models. The approach emphasizes constraining agents with domain concepts to improve reliability, governance, and explainability in complex workflows.
items.summary_zh: 把领域驱动设计的思路用于自律智能体，使代理的决策和行为受业务领域模型的约束。此方法旨在提高在复杂工作流中的可控性、可解释性和治理能力。

items.title_en: Spark: Sparklines in your shell
items.title_zh: Spark：在命令行中显示 Sparklines 的工具
items.summary_en: Spark brings inline sparklines to the shell, turning numeric streams into compact visual summaries without leaving the terminal. It makes quick trend spotting possible in scripts and day-to-day command work.
items.summary_zh: Spark 将内联火花图带入命令行，使数字流在不离开终端的情况下被压缩成可视摘要。它让在脚本和日常命令工作中快速感知趋势成为可能。

items.title_en: TurboKV: Insanely fast Rust key-value store
items.title_zh: TurboKV：极快的 Rust 键值存储
items.summary_en: TurboKV is a Rust-based key-value store touted for blazing speed, likely employing lock-free data structures and modern memory strategies. It targets high-throughput workloads for databases and caches, offering a practical signal of Rust's viability for storage engines.
items.summary_zh: TurboKV 是基于 Rust 的高性能键值存储，主打极致速度，可能采用无锁设计和最新的内存管理策略。它面向数据库和缓存等高吞吐场景，提供了 Rust 驱动存储引擎的新参考。

items.title_en: Quantifying Colour
items.title_zh: 色彩量化
items.summary_en: Quantifying Colour explores metrics and methods to measure and compare colors—bridging perception, mathematics, and display technology. The piece delves into color spaces, differences, and practical implications for design and visualization.
items.summary_zh: 色彩量化探讨了衡量与比较颜色的度量与方法，连接了感知、数学与显示技术。文章深入讨论了色彩空间、色差以及对设计与可视化的实际影响。

items.title_en: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers
items.title_zh: 柏林正遭黑客勒索
items.summary_en: Berlin has faced ransomware pressure targeting municipal services, raising concerns about city resilience and critical infrastructure security.
items.summary_zh: 柏林的市政服务遭遇勒索攻击，凸显城市韧性与关键基础设施安全的挑战。强调为城市系统建立强健的网络防护与应急响应能力的重要性。

items.title_en: Open Oscar Server: open-source server compatible with AIM and ICQ clients
items.title_zh: Open Oscar Server：与 AIM/ICQ 客户端兼容的开源服务器
items.summary_en: Open Oscar Server provides an open-source server implementation for the OSCAR protocol used by AIM/ICQ-era clients, enabling hobbyists to run retro chat networks. It highlights interoperability and nostalgia-driven open-source projects.
items.summary_zh: Open Oscar Server 提供了一个用于 AIM/ICQ 协议的开源服务器实现，让爱好者能够运行复古聊天网络。凸显互操作性与开源社区在怀旧领域的活力。

items.title_en: The Twelve-Factor App (2025)
items.title_zh: 十二因子应用原则
items.summary_en: An established methodology for building SaaS apps that are portable and maintainable. It codifies best practices around config, dependencies, backing services, build/run release, logs, and parity between development and production environments.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向 SaaS 应用的成熟架构方法论，强调应用配置、依赖、后端服务、构建/运行/发布、日志，以及开发和生产环境的一致性等最佳实践。

items.title_en: Indirect Calling of Nested Functions on GCC Without Executable Stack
items.title_zh: GCC 在无可执行栈情况下对嵌套函数的间接调用
items.summary_en: GCC can call nested functions indirectly even when the executable stack is disabled, using a small trampoline-type mechanism. This approach enables certain C language patterns that rely on nested functions while preserving modern security hardening.
items.summary_zh: GCC 即使在禁用可执行栈的情况下，也能通过一个小型跳板机制实现对嵌套函数的间接调用。这种做法在不牺牲安全性堆栈防护的前提下，支持依赖嵌套函数的 C 语言写法。

items.title_en: Trees for a Changing Climate and Resilient Urban Forest (2022)
items.title_zh: 应对气候变化的树木与韧性城市森林（2022）
items.summary_en: Reviews tree species and urban forestry strategies to build climate-resilient urban canopies; addresses heat, drought, pests, and urban stressors; provides guidance for city planners and residents.
items.summary_zh: 《应对气候变化的树木与韧性城市森林》聚焦于城市树种选择与森林管理，帮助构建耐热、耐旱、抗虫害的城市树冠。为城市规划者和居民提供可操作的指南。

items.title_en: My fat loss experiments with ChatGPT and water fasting
items.title_zh: 我在减脂中的 ChatGPT 与水禁食实验
items.summary_en: A personal account documents fat-loss experiments guided by ChatGPT alongside water fasting, sharing outcomes and cautions. It prompts reflection on AI-assisted wellness experiments and safe boundaries for machine-guided health advice.
items.summary_zh: 个人记录展示了在 ChatGPT 指导下进行的减脂尝试，结合水禁食，分享结果与注意事项。此文引发对 AI 辅助健康实验及机器建议安全边界的思考。

items.title_en: A safe MySQL upgrade that wasn't so safe
items.title_zh: 一次看似安全的 MySQL 升级其实并不安全
items.summary_en: The post recounts a MySQL upgrade that seemed safe but introduced surprises due to subtle config and compatibility pitfalls. It underscores the importance of staging upgrades, validating replicas, and having rollbacks when database migrations touch schemas or defaults.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了一次看似安全但实则充满隐患的 MySQL 升级，暴露了配置和兼容性中的细微问题。强调在升级前进行阶段性验证、对副本进行测试以及准备回滚方案。

items.title_en: Casey Muratori – The Root of the Root of All Evil – BSC 2026 [video]
items.title_zh: Casey Muratori——万恶之源的根源——BSC 2026 [视频]
items.summary_en: Casey Muratori's BSC 2026 talk digs into systemic issues behind software fragility and how reliance on hidden caches, build processes, and vendor ecosystems compounds risk. It makes a case for simpler, auditable tooling and practices.
items.summary_zh: Casey Muratori 在 BSC 2026 的演讲聚焦软件生态中的脆弱性根源，以及隐藏的构建过程和依赖链如何放大风险。呼吁回归简单、可审计的工具与工作方式。

items.title_en: Nvidia's AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
items.title_zh: 英伟达的人工智能优势正在超越 GPU
items.summary_en: Nvidia is expanding its AI lead beyond GPUs into software ecosystems, DPUs, and cloud-native tools, signaling a shift toward hardware-software co-design for enterprise AI. The move could redefine performance expectations and vendor dynamics in data centers.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达正在将 AI 优势扩展到超越 GPU 的软件生态、DPUs 和云原生工具，预示着面向企业 AI 的软硬件协同设计的转变。这一举措可能重塑数据中心的性能预期与厂商格局。

items.title_en: When fruit is scarce, these monkeys hunt animals
items.title_zh: 果实稀缺时，这些猴子会捕猎动物
items.summary_en: Researchers observed certain monkey species switch to meat-eating when fruit is scarce, offering clues about the origins of meat consumption in humans and the flexibility of primate foraging strategies.
items.summary_zh: 研究者发现部分猴子在果实短缺时转向捕猎动物，提供了人类肉食起源与灵活的灵长类取食策略的线索。

items.title_en: EVE Online moves to Python 3
items.title_zh: EVE Online 移动到 Python 3
items.summary_en: EVE Online moves its codebase to Python 3, reflecting the broader industry push to modernize Python 2-era backends. The migration highlights challenges around compatibility, performance, and live-service uptime in a large, live MMO.
items.summary_zh: EVE Online 将代码库迁移到 Python 3，体现了行业普遍向 Python 3 过渡的趋势。迁移在兼容性、性能与在线服务的连续性方面暴露了大型实时游戏后端的挑战。

items.title_en: The Internet Archive's Vintage AI Collection
items.title_zh: 互联网档案馆的复古 AI 收藏
items.summary_en: A tour of the Internet Archive's Vintage AI collection, featuring historical papers, programs, and manuals. It highlights how archiving early AI work helps researchers understand historical context and evolution.
items.summary_zh: 介绍互联网档案馆的复古 AI 收藏，包含历史论文、程序与手册。强调档案化早期人工智能工作对研究者理解历史背景与演进的重要性。

items.title_en: Memo to Ridley Scott: no one needs more Alien: Covenant movies
items.title_zh: 致 Ridley Scott 的备忘：不需要更多《异形：契约》电影
items.summary_en: Critics argue that continuing the Alien: Covenant line risks burning out the franchise, urging fresh directions or a return to roots. The piece weighs the market appetite against creative sustainability.
items.summary_zh: 评论者认为若继续扩展《异形》系列的 Covenant 线可能会让系列疲态尽显，呼吁走向新方向或回归经典。文章权衡市场需求与创作的可持续性。

items.title_en: Tether: iMessage, SMS, etc. on Linux
items.title_zh: Tether：在 Linux 上实现 iMessage、SMS 等通信
items.summary_en: A project called Tether lets Linux users access iMessage and SMS by bridging to an iPhone, bringing Apple’s messaging to Linux desktop. It highlights the friction-filled gap between ecosystems and how open-source tooling can bridge messaging across platforms.
items.summary_zh: 一个名为 Tether 的项目让 Linux 用户通过与 iPhone 桥接来使用 iMessage、SMS 等消息，将 Apple 的消息生态带到 Linux 桌面。它凸显了不同生态系统之间的割裂，以及开源工具如何构建跨平台的消息桥接。

items.title_en: Creating the Aetheryte Radio
items.title_zh: 创建 Aetheryte 电台
items.summary_en: Creating the Aetheryte Radio documents a DIY project to spin up a radio station inspired by fantasy themes, likely using standard streaming software and hardware. The write-up blends tinkering with a playful branding approach and shows how accessible radio streaming has become.
items.summary_zh: 创建 Aetheryte 电台记录了一个 DIY 项目，旨在搭建一个受幻想题材启发的广播电台，可能基于常见的流媒体软件与硬件。文中将动手实践与趣味品牌结合，展现了如今广播流媒体的可获得性。

items.title_en: Glacier Mice
items.title_zh: 冰川苔球现象
items.summary_en: Glacier Mice are moss-covered stones that drift across ice sheets, propelled by wind and thermal updrafts. They illustrate micro-ecosystem dynamics in extreme environments and offer a quirky example of how life survives on moving glacial surfaces.
items.summary_zh: 冰川苔球是在冰川上由苔藓覆盖的石块，受风和地热上升气流驱动缓慢移动。这一现象揭示极端环境中的微型生态系统动力学，为研究生物地理与微栖息地提供有趣案例。

items.title_en: RISC-V is now officially supported by CPython
items.title_zh: CPython 正式支持 RISC-V
items.summary_en: CPython now officially supports RISC-V, expanding Python adoption on the RISC-V ecosystem. This brings official builds and better portability for developers on open hardware, including embedded and hobbyist boards.
items.summary_zh: CPython 现正式支持 RISC-V，扩大了在 RISC-V 生态系统中的 Python 采纳度。这为使用开源硬件的开发者，尤其是在嵌入式和爱好者板上，带来官方构建与更好的可移植性。

items.title_en: SQLite as a Document Database (2020)
items.title_zh: SQLite 作为文档数据库（2020）
items.summary_en: SQLite has long been a relational DB, but with JSON1 and related features you can model document-like data inside SQLite. The piece surveys practical patterns for storing, indexing, and querying JSON documents in SQLite, showing how it can act as a lightweight document store for local apps without a separate NoSQL layer.
items.summary_zh: SQLite 长期以关系型数据库著称，但借助 JSON1 等特性，仍可在其中建模文档型数据。文章给出在 SQLite 中存储、索引与查询 JSON 文档的实用模式，展示其在本地应用中充当轻量级文档存储的可行性与取舍。

items.title_en: Europe's last regular standard-gauge steam passenger service
items.title_zh: 欧洲最后一班常规标准轨距蒸汽客运列车
items.summary_en: Europe is winding down its last regular standard-gauge steam passenger service, marking the end of an era for mainstream steam on standard gauge. The development underscores how rail modernization has displaced steam even where preservation groups keep heritage services running, highlighting the fragility and value of legacy traction.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲最后一班常规标准轨距蒸汽客运列车已经退役，标志着标准轨距蒸汽在主流铁路中的时代落幕。铁路现代化推动替代，遗产铁路仍在运作的同时也暴露出传统蒸汽机车的脆弱性与历史价值。

items.title_en: Hunting Down a Go Runtime Bug on 32-Bit Embedded Systems
items.title_zh: 在32位嵌入式系统上定位Go运行时Bug
items.summary_en: Go's runtime bug on 32-bit embedded targets complicates networked applications in constrained devices. The write-up walks through debugging the netpoll issue and highlights how the Go scheduler and polling behave differently on 32-bit architectures, underscoring maintenance challenges for embedded Go projects.
items.summary_zh: 针对32位嵌入式目标，Go运行时的netpoll组件出现缺陷，使受限设备上的网络相关程序变得不稳定。博文给出调试要点，揭示32位体系上的调度器和轮询机制的细节，突出嵌入式Go项目的维护难度。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Pocket-Scale Inference
items.title_zh: 袖珍级推理基准测试
items.summary_en: A practical look at AI inference on pocket-scale devices, comparing model sizes, quantization levels, and energy use across popular mobile stacks. The findings help developers choose the right trade-offs for on-device AI, balancing latency, battery life, and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 对袖珍级设备上的 AI 推理进行实用比较，涵盖模型大小、量化级别及在不同移动栈上的能耗差异。结果帮助开发者在延迟、续航与隐私之间权衡，做出更合适的本地化推理选择。

items.title_en: Daycare Pseudoscience
items.title_zh: 托育领域的伪科学
items.summary_en: A critical look at seemingly scientific daycare claims, unpacking misleading research and real evidence-based practices. It discusses how pseudoscience shapes policy and parent choices, urging rigor.
items.summary_zh: 对托育领域中看似科学的主张进行批判性审视，揭示误导性研究与真实循证实践之间的差距。讨论伪科学如何影响政策与家长选择，并呼吁更严格的证据标准。

items.title_en: Show HN: Typebase – A single-folder back end you write in TypeScript
items.title_zh: Show HN：Typebase — 用 TypeScript 编写、放在单一文件夹里的后端
items.summary_en: Typebase is a minimalist backend you implement inside a single TypeScript folder, aiming to sidestep traditional server boilerplate. It demonstrates a compact, portable back-end technique that may appeal to hobbyists or early-stage apps wanting quick local backends.
items.summary_zh: Typebase 是一个极简后端，你只需在单一 TypeScript 文件夹中实现即可，意在规避传统服务器样板代码。它展示了一种紧减、可移植的后端实现方式，适合爱好者或希望快速搭建本地后端的应用场景。

items.title_en: Time complexity of operations on Python's built-in types
items.title_zh: Python 内置类型操作的时间复杂度
items.summary_en: Python's documentation outlines the time complexity of operations on built-in types, such as O(1) average-case lookups for dict and O(n) for list traversals. Knowing these costs helps developers write more performance-aware Python code and choose appropriate data structures.
items.summary_zh: Python 的官方文档列出内置类型常用操作的时间复杂度，例如字典查找的平均时间为常数级，列表遍历通常为线性时间。了解这些成本有助于开发者编写更具性能意识的代码，并选择合适的数据结构。

items.title_en: The Einstein-Szilard Refrigerator (2020)
items.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-西拉德冰箱（2020）
items.summary_en: The Einstein-Szilard refrigerator recounts an early design for a safe, maintenance-free cooling machine developed by Einstein and Szilard.
items.summary_zh: 爱因斯坦与西拉德共同设计的一款早期安全、免维护制冷机的故事被回顾。文章强调了这一科学家合作背景下的发明，以及关于节能制冷的持久问题。

items.title_en: Electric rain can eat through metal
items.title_zh: 电雨能侵蚀金属
items.summary_en: Electric rain describes a phenomenon where electrically charged rain droplets or arcing environments accelerate corrosion of metals.
items.summary_zh: 电雨现象指带电雨滴或放电环境加速金属腐蚀。文章探讨这一现象对基础设施、航空航天和电子设备的影响，以及在材料与涂层选型上可能需要的改进。

items.title_en: Dad’s Custom Atari Peripherals
items.title_zh: 父亲的定制雅达利外设
items.summary_en: A showcase of a maker's retro hardware project: custom Atari peripherals that blend nostalgia with practical electronics tinkering. It highlights how hobbyists repurpose classic platforms to build bespoke controllers and expand capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 展示了一位爱好者对雅达利平台的复古硬件项目，定制外设将怀旧与实际电子制作结合。它强调爱好者如何改造经典硬件来打造专属控制器并扩展功能。

items.title_en: Show HN: Galaxium, an experimental WebGPU space explorer
items.title_zh: Show HN：Galaxium，一款实验性的 WebGPU 空间探索应用
items.summary_en: Galaxium is a browser-based space visualization tool built with WebGPU, demonstrating GPU-accelerated rendering in a web app. It shows how WebGPU can enable high-fidelity, interactive space exploration without native code, with potential uses in education and data visualization.
items.summary_zh: Galaxium 是一个基于浏览器的太空可视化工具，利用 WebGPU 实现 GPU 加速渲染。它展示了在无需本地代码的情况下实现高保真、交互式太空探索的可能性，适合教育与数据可视化场景。

items.title_en: What my dad taught me about AI coding in the 90s
items.title_zh: 我父亲在 90 年代教我的 AI 编码
items.summary_en: A personal essay recounts lessons learned from a dad about AI coding in the 1990s, emphasizing pragmatic techniques, experimentation, and skepticism toward hype. It connects past practices to modern AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆父亲在九十年代教他 AI 编码的经验，强调务实的技巧、反复试验以及对噱头的谨慎。把往昔做法与当下的 AI 工具联系起来。

items.title_en: JupyterGIS 0.16: a grammar of graphics for maps, and collaborative story maps
items.title_zh: JupyterGIS 0.16：地图的图形学语法与协作式故事地图
items.summary_en: JupyterGIS 0.16 introduces a grammar-of-graphics approach to maps and adds collaborative storytelling maps, enabling richer geospatial narratives in notebooks. The update strengthens data visualization and teamwork in geospatial workflows.
items.summary_zh: JupyterGIS 0.16 引入了地图的图形学语法，并新增协作式故事地图，使笔记本中的地理空间叙事更加丰富。此更新提升了地理空间工作流中的数据可视化与协作能力。

items.title_en: Orbs
items.title_zh: Orbs（球体）
items.summary_en: Orbs is explained as a lightweight, modular concept aimed at consolidating interchangeable components into a cohesive architecture.
items.summary_zh: Orbs 被解释为一种轻量、模块化的概念，旨在将可替换的组件整合成一个协作一致的架构。

items.title_en: Show HN: I missed the moving blocks, so I built a real Linux disk defragmenter
items.title_zh: Show HN：我错过了移动块，因此做了一个真正的 Linux 磁盘碎片整理工具
items.summary_en: A Show HN post about building a genuine Linux defragmenter after missing the kernel's moving-block mechanisms. It discusses approach, limitations, and what it means for performance on modern filesystems.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 分享者在错过内核的移动块特性后，亲自实现了一个真正的 Linux 磁盘碎片整理工具。介绍实现思路、局限性及对现代文件系统性能的影响。

items.title_en: Creating Teensy ELF Executables for Linux (Or, "Size Is Everything") (1999)
items.title_zh: 为 Linux 创建极小的 Teensy ELF 可执行文件（尺寸就是一切）
items.summary_en: A tour of crafting ultra-small Linux executables for Teensy environments, emphasizing size optimizations and minimalist toolchains. The piece demonstrates how tiny binaries enable constrained devices to boot Linux in edge cases.
items.summary_zh: 介绍为 Teensy 与极小 Linux 环境打造超小可执行文件的技巧，强调尺寸优化与极简工具链的重要性。展示在受限设备上实现 Linux 引导的可行性与边缘场景。

items.title_en: Sleepwalker: Passive Backdoor with Its Own Command Language
items.title_zh: Sleepwalker：具备自身命令语言的被动后门
items.summary_en: Sleepwalker describes a passive backdoor that operates with its own command language, aiming to minimize detectability by remaining dormant until triggered. It underscores the evolving threat of covert backdoors and the need for defenders to monitor unusual command channels.
items.summary_zh: Sleepwalker 描述了一种被动后门，其自身具备命令语言，旨在通过在被触发前保持休眠来降低被发现的概率。这凸显了隐蔽后门的演变趋势，也提醒安全人员监控异常的指令通道。

items.title_en: Recovering Corrupt Zip Files
items.title_zh: 恢复损坏的 Zip 文件
items.summary_en: Guides readers through practical recovery techniques for corrupted ZIP files, including built-in repair modes, alternate extraction methods, and data carving tips. Also shares preventive tips to reduce zip archive failures.
items.summary_zh: 该文介绍从损坏的 ZIP 文件中恢复数据的实用方法，包括修复模式、替代提取方式以及数据分割技巧，同时给出预防 ZIP 损坏的最佳实践。

items.title_en: Is it safe to call print in a Python signal handler?
items.title_zh: 在 Python 信号处理器中调用 print 安全吗？
items.summary_en: A careful look at Python signal handlers and what operations are safe within them. The article warns that printing from a signal handler can cause reentrancy issues or I/O pitfalls, suggesting safer patterns like flag-setting.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Python 信号处理程序中的安全性，指出在信号处理函数中执行打印可能带来重入和 I/O 风险，建议使用标志位等更安全的模式来传达信号信息。

items.title_en: Storm Summoner, a MIDI controller for effects pedals
items.title_zh: Storm Summoner：用于效果器踏板的 MIDI 控制器
items.summary_en: Storm Summoner is a MIDI controller designed to manipulate guitar effects pedals, enabling expressive, hands-on control for performances. It suggests modular patching, presets, and real-time parameter tweaks that can streamline live rigs.
items.summary_zh: Storm Summoner 是一款用于控制吉他效果器踏板的 MIDI 控制器，便于在演出中实现更具表现力的现场操控。它支持预设、模块化补丁和实时参数调整，能提升现场演出工作流的灵活性。

items.title_en: A few feral cats in an ALGOL trenchcoat.
items.title_zh: ALGOL 风衣中的几只野猫
items.summary_en: A whimsical piece weaving metaphor about old ALGOL language with modern programming culture; highlights nostalgia and language design debates.
items.summary_zh: 以 ALGOL 这门古老语言为素材，穿上现代编程文化的外衣，描绘怀旧与语言设计讨论的趣味场景。

items.title_en: Synchronisation and SMPTE timecode (time code)
items.title_zh: 同步与 SMPTE 时间码
items.summary_en: A deep dive into timecode synchronization, SMPTE standards, and their practical use in film, video, and live productions. It covers how timecode coordinates multi-camera shoots and post-production workflows.
items.summary_zh: 深入解读时间码与 SMPTE 标准，以及在影视与现场制作中的实际应用，如何用于多机位拍摄的同步与后期工作流。

items.title_en: Pop-2000, a lingua-franca POP-2 dialect
items.title_zh: Pop-2000：一种 POP-2 方言的通用语言
items.summary_en: Introduces Pop-2000, a lingua franca dialect of POP-2 designed to facilitate communication across language ecosystems. The post delves into design goals and potential use cases for retro-inspired language tooling.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Pop-2000，一种以 POP-2 为基础的通用方言，旨在促进不同语言生态的互操作。探讨设计目标及在复古风格语言工具中的潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: Sort branches by last commit date
items.title_zh: 按最后提交日期对分支排序
items.summary_en: A practical Git tip for repository hygiene: sorting branches by their most recent commit date helps identify stale branches and clean up workflows. It can save time on large repos and reveal active areas of work for teams.
items.summary_zh: 一个实用的 Git 技巧，按最近一次提交日期对分支进行排序，能帮助识别已过时的分支并优化工作流。对于大型仓库尤其有用，可以节省时间并凸显活跃的开发区域。

items.title_en: My life was changed by four sentences in four books
items.title_zh: 四本书中的四句话改变了我的生活
items.summary_en: A reflective piece credits four sentences from four books as pivotal moments, showing how a few words can crystallize big ideas. It offers a concise meditation on the power of literature to shape thinking.
items.summary_zh: 一篇反思文章将四本书中的四句话视为关键时刻，展示几句话如何凝练出重大思想。文章对文学改变思考方式的力量做了简明的沉思。
